statBlock.name: Grung Wildling
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The wildling breathes air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the wildling or otherwise touches its bare skin must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature becomes poisoned for 1 minute. Once it breaks direct contact, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Standing Leap. The wildling can long jump up to 25 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft. from a standstill or with a running start.
Water Dependency. At the end of a day when the wildling has spent less than 1 hour immersed in water, it gains one level of exhaustion. It can recover from this exhaustion through magic or by immersing itself for at least 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 12).
At will. Druidcraft.
2/day. Plant Growth.
3/day each. Cure Wounds, Spike Growth.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
Optional rule. Choose the effect that matches the wildling's color. When the wildling poisons a creature, that creature suffers the chosen effect until its poisoned condition from this wildling ends.
Blue. The creature must make a loud noise at both the start and the end of each of its turns.
Gold. The creature is charmed by the wildling and gains the ability to speak Grung.
Green. The creature can move only by climbing or making standing jumps. While flying, it can take actions or reactions only after it lands.
Orange. The creature is frightened of its allies.
Purple. The creature feels compelled to soak in liquid or mud. It can move and take actions only to soak or reach liquid or mud.
Red. If food is within reach, the creature must use its action to eat.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 150.
